verdict.rationale: LM Studio's docs describe downloading and running LLMs locally via llama.cpp or Apple MLX, in the GUI, the CLI (`lms load`, `lms chat`) and the headless llmster daemon. They also say document chat (RAG) works entirely offline and the server stays on localhost unless network access is explicitly turned on. Community users corroborate running models locally on their own hardware. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party guarantee that text prompts and chat data never leave the device (the only explicit 'never leaves your device' statement covers Bionic voice data), and independent verification of no outbound telemetry or network calls during inference.
